# JoobEscrow

> JoobEscrow is a non-custodial escrow protocol on BNB Chain. A client locks USDT or USDC in an audited smart contract, the provider accepts and delivers, and the client releases the funds. Nobody in the middle holds the money: a 3-of-5 Safe multisig owns the contracts and only settles disputes. The app is live at https://www.joobescrow.com/app.

## What it is for
- Paying freelancers, developers, designers, auditors, KOLs and agencies safely in crypto.
- OTC token deals, domain sales, gaming assets and any deal between two parties who do not trust each other yet.
- Communities (OTC groups, forums, marketplaces) that want their members to trade without a middleman.

## How a deal works
1. The client creates an escrow and locks the amount (USDT or USDC, BEP-20) in the contract.
2. The provider accepts. Before that, the client can cancel and get a full refund.
3. The provider delivers. The client releases the payment.
4. If the provider accepted and the delivery deadline passes, the provider can claim the payment.
5. Either party can open a dispute while the escrow is funded. The 3-of-5 Safe settles it on-chain. If a dispute stays unsettled for 30 days, either party can trigger a 50/50 split.
6. Funds are credited to each party's balance in the contract and withdrawn with "Withdraw" (pull payments).

## Fees
- 0% for the client.
- The provider pays 5% under $1,000, 3% from $1,000 to $9,999.99, and 2% from $10,000 to $100,000.
- Amounts from 1 to 100,000 USDT or USDC. Minimum delivery deadline: 3 days.

## Main pages
- App home (Pay someone, Get paid): https://www.joobescrow.com/app
- Get paid, create a payment request link: https://www.joobescrow.com/pay
- Pay button for a website or a community: https://www.joobescrow.com/pay-button
- Try the full cycle with $1 between two of your own wallets (0% fee): https://www.joobescrow.com/try
- Public deal page, read-only, no wallet needed: https://www.joobescrow.com/deal/<category>/<id>?c=<contract>
- Public reputation of a wallet, on-chain facts only: https://www.joobescrow.com/u/<address>
- Security, audits and all contract addresses: https://www.joobescrow.com/security
- How disputes work: https://www.joobescrow.com/how-disputes-work
- FAQ: https://www.joobescrow.com/faq
- Whitepaper: https://www.joobescrow.com/whitepaper

## Features live today
- Payment request links and a copyable "Pay with JoobEscrow" button for any website.
- End-to-end encrypted chat between the two parties (XMTP), with file sharing up to 1 MB per file.
- Dispute evidence: the fingerprint of a file can be recorded on-chain, never its content.
- PDF receipt of any escrow, generated from on-chain data.
- Public reputation profile of any wallet: completed deals, volume, disputes, counterparties.
- Pay from 6 other EVM chains through LI.FI for the JOOB presale.

## JOOB token
- Utility token of the protocol: planned fee reductions, governance and staking.
- Fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 JOOB, no mint. Team and treasury allocations are locked in vesting contracts.
- Presale: https://www.joobescrow.com/presale (ends January 13, 2027 at 13:59:59 UTC). Any JOOB token offered outside the official presale is a fake.

We never ask for a seed phrase and never ask anyone to connect a wallet inside Telegram.

## Public API (read-only, no key)
- Base URL: https://api.joobescrow.com
- GET /fees: fee grid by deal size
- GET /deal?contract=<address>&id=<id>: status, amount and parties of one escrow
- GET /reputation?address=<address>: on-chain track record of a wallet (paid contracts only)
- GET /paylink?provider=<address>&amount=<optional>&token=<USDT|USDC>&category=<optional>&ref=<optional>: pre-filled payment request link

## Telegram bot
- https://t.me/JoobEscrowBot: fees, deal status, wallet reputation, payment request links, and personal alerts when an escrow of a tracked wallet changes. Read-only: it never asks for a wallet connection.

## For AI agents
See https://www.joobescrow.com/agents.md for what an agent can and cannot do with JoobEscrow.
